{{Quote|The ion storms of Moorja have prevented the deployment of our standard battle-droid forces, but Neimoidian Gunnery Battalions, Gossam Commandos and Koorivar Fusiliers have consolidated to provide Moorja with cost-effective protective forces.|[[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]]|<ref name="CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 15:3:21 Edition">{{InsiderCite|76|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 15:3:21 Edition}}</ref>}}
'''Ion storms''' were a [[Realspace/Legends|space]] phenomena that could cause problems during space travel for the denizens of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

Created by a release of magnetic energy within a [[Star/Legends|star]], ion storms were fast-moving bursts of [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] that radiated outward into the surrounding [[Star system/Legends|star system]]. They were considered dangerous, as they had the potential to wreak havoc on bodies unprotected by a [[Magnetic field/Legends|magnetic field]]. [[Starship/Legends|Starships]] were particularly vulnerable and, as ion storms could knock out [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielding]] and a ship's electrical systems (compare [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]]), they were avoided wherever possible.
